lines.text: Timothy is told to be strong in the grace in Christ Jesus and entrust what he heard to faithful men.
Timothy is to suffer like a good soldier, who avoids civilian affairs to please the one who enlisted him.
A competitor must follow the rules to receive the crown, and the hardworking shepherd should partake of the crops.
Jesus Christ was raised from the dead and descended from Abraham, and the gospel's preacher is chained like a criminal.
If we endure we will reign with Him, and if we are faithless, He stays faithful.
